## English

The three files listed above are unmodified from the official 3.1.2 amalgamation ZIP. The pinned commit is `77d0dce8627735138c51770d1799a1ef48f2117d`. See `LICENSE` for the MIT terms and the table above for the SHA-256 checksums. The ZIP checksum was checked against the official GitHub release digest.
